entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Hey, I got a call from the school.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I hear you ditched half a day on your[n]first day of school.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Yeah, yeah... That's what everyone says[n]when they're caught.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ugh, just when I was thinking you had it[n]together this morning...

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Didn't I tell you not to cause any trouble?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: One wrong step and your life is over.[n]You do know what probation means,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...Yeah, I just closed up shop. I'll head[n]over in half an hour, as promised.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: What're you standing around for?[n]Get upstairs and go to bed already.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...No, it's a guy. I just hired[n]a part-timer.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't forget to lock the door and[n]turn all the lights off, okay?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I told you, he's a part-timer...
